name: HSE Open 2018

venue.name: [National Research University Higher School of Economics](https://www.hse.ru/en/)
venue.address: Staraya Basmannaya st., 21/4 building 1, Moscow, Russia

information:
Registration will be closed on February 2nd. When we reach 200 competitors all remaining registrations will be kept in waiting list. If a vacant place appears the next registration in waiting list will be accepted. Please be warned that all competitors that are in waiting list are **not** considered spectators. If you want to come to spectate you can register separately. More information in our [VK group](https://vk.com/hseopen20xx)

Registration fee is **300 RUB** (~5 USD) and **FREE** for Higher School of Economics students and students of schools associated with HSE. The fees are accepted during the competition days at the venue. **There will not be pre-payment**. 

All spectators and guests are free to visit but they will need to register separately. More information in our [VK group](https://vk.com/hseopen20xx)

Please check your e-mail regularly so you don't miss any important message from the organization team. Also, there will be a lot of useful information in [VK group](https://vk.com/hseopen20xx) so be sure to check it out.
**If your registration isn't accepted within 48 hours please contact us so we can resolve the situation**
